name: read_conversation
author: OpenAgents
description: Read a conversation back from this machine: the transcript of a Claude Code or Codex CLI session, returned as ordered turns of user and assistant text. Use it when asked to read a convo, conversation, chat, or session transcript — the latest one here, or one named by session id, or the newest under a working directory. Read-only and bounded: thinking and tool activity are counted rather than replayed, long conversations return their most recent turns and say how many were dropped, and oversized session files are read from the tail. It never resumes, continues, or writes anything.

source.description: Which store holds the session. Both are searched when omitted.

session_id.description: The session to read, by id or id prefix. The newest session wins when omitted.

cwd_filter.description: Only consider sessions whose working directory contains this substring.

max_turns.description: Most turns to return, from the end of the conversation. Default 60, capped at 200.

max_chars.description: Character ceiling per turn; longer turns keep their head and tail. Default 2000, capped at 8000.

now_ms.description: Current time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, for the recency window. The sandbox has no clock; when omitted, the newest session's own timestamp stands in.

tail_only.description: True when the file exceeded the whole-read bound, so only its tail was read.
